summary: The Sokoban board drew the worker, crates and goals as about 12px glyphs in 50-76px tiles, and its walls as pale tiles with cream grout over a dark floor, so the walls outweighed the pieces and figure and ground were inverted. Walls are now dark solid blocks on a light floor, and each piece is an outlined token about 70% of its tile wide, in the player and the builder alike.
